name: Omascout Glucose Widget
author: vulturetone
description: Display Current glucose from a Nightscout site, using server's thresholds, with an optional derived sensor-expiry warning

barWidget.description: Glucose pill with trend and delta, plus a popup showing sensor age and expiry.

schema.label: Nightscout URL
schema.description: Base URL of your Nightscout site, e.g. https://mysite.example.com:1337. Required.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Most uploaders post about once a minute; polling faster than that only adds load.

schema.label: Access token file
schema.description: File holding a read-only Nightscout token. Optional: a site with AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES=readable needs none. Keep it outside any directory your dotfile manager syncs. Defaults to ~/.config/nightscout-token.

schema.label: Sensor wear time (days)
schema.description: 0 disables sensor tracking. Set to your sensor's wear time (Libre 2: 14, Libre 2 Plus: 15, Dexcom G6: 10) to derive expiry from the first reading carrying each serial. Only meaningful when your uploader forwards a serial in the entry's device field and posts no sensor-change treatments.

schema.label: Sensor warmup (minutes)
schema.description: Backdated off the first reading to estimate the activation time.

schema.label: Warn when this close to expiry (hours)
Stale after (minutes)
schema.description: Minutes without a new reading before the pill greys out.
